Stock Markets Dip as Crude Oil Prices Surge Amid Geopolitical Uncertainty

Indian stock markets experienced a decline in early trading on August 18, 2026, with the BSE Sensex falling by 278.32 points to 77,450.64 and the NSE Nifty down by 57.65 points to 24,230.45. This downturn coincided with a rise in crude oil prices, which jumped to $91 per barrel. The increase in oil prices is linked to uncertainty in West Asia, specifically the expiration of a US-Iran ceasefire window. Realty and IT stocks were noted as contributing to the market's decline.
